question.text: Credit Default Swap (CDS) buyer pays premium to seller for:

answer.text: Protection against credit events (default, downgrade) on a reference entity

explanation.text: The Logic: CDS = credit insurance. Pay premium, receive payout if credit event triggers. The Trap: CDS doesn't transfer bond ownership. Cross-Exam Context: IV, Topic 19. Manager's Pro-Tip: Indian CDS market is shallow; position-sizing beats CDS for credit-risk mitigation.
